text: Good evening, I'm messaging about my stepson Mateo, he's 4 months old. His mum is on a night shift so it's just me tonight, ok lang naman, but I took his temp a little while ago and it said 39.9. I did it twice to be sure and the second one was the same. He's been a bit hot to hold since about tea time, mainit talaga yung likod niya, so I took the extra blanket off. The other thing is his eczema is acting up again. The dry patches behind his knees and on his cheeks have gone rough and he keeps rubbing his face on my shoulder like it's botherin him, kawawa naman. I put his usual cream on before bed. I think the flare and the temprature are probably seperate things but I'm not 100% sure, maybe they're connected? His mum said to just ring if the number went high, and 39.9 seems high for a baby that small, so here I am. I just want to know what we should be doing with him tonight. Salamat po.
